title: Fiber / HTTP Overview
description: Request rate, errors and latency of Fiber applications instrumented with the gofiber/contrib prometheus middleware.

list.name: prefix
list.label: Metric prefix
list.description: Namespace and Subsystem the middleware was configured with, joined by an underscore. "http" unless Config.Namespace or Config.Subsystem were changed.

list.name: service
list.label: Service
list.description: The service label set through Config.ServiceName. Empty when it is not configured.

panels.title: Request rate
panels.description: Requests per second across the selection, from requests_total.

targets.expr: sum(rate(${prefix}_requests_total{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: 5xx errors
panels.description: Share of requests answered with a 5xx status.

targets.expr:
(
  sum(rate(${prefix}_requests_total{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", status_code=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval]))
  or
  sum(rate(${prefix}_requests_total{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) * 0
)
/
sum(rate(${prefix}_requests_total{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: 4xx errors
panels.description: Share of requests answered with a 4xx status.

targets.expr:
(
  sum(rate(${prefix}_requests_total{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", status_code=~"4.."}[$__rate_interval]))
  or
  sum(rate(${prefix}_requests_total{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) * 0
)
/
sum(rate(${prefix}_requests_total{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Latency p50
panels.description: p50 of request duration over the last rate interval, from request_duration_seconds.

targets.expr:
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (rate(${prefix}_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])))
or
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum(rate(${prefix}_request_duration_seconds{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Latency p99
panels.description: p99 of request duration over the last rate interval, from request_duration_seconds.

targets.expr:
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(${prefix}_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])))
or
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(${prefix}_request_duration_seconds{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: In flight
panels.description: Requests currently being handled, from requests_in_progress. Sampled at scrape time.

targets.expr: sum(${prefix}_requests_in_progress{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Requests by status class
panels.description: Request rate stacked by status class. The class is derived from status_code, so this panel works with requests_status_class_total disabled.

targets.expr: sum by (status_class) (label_replace(rate(${prefix}_requests_total{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]), "status_class", "${1}xx", "status_code", "(.).."))

panels.title: Requests by instance
panels.description: Request rate per scraped instance — an uneven split points at load balancing or a sick replica.

targets.expr: sum by (instance) (rate(${prefix}_requests_total{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Error ratio
panels.description: Share of requests answered with a 5xx (server errors) or a 4xx (client errors).

targets.expr:
(
  sum(rate(${prefix}_requests_total{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", status_code=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval]))
  or
  sum(rate(${prefix}_requests_total{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) * 0
)
/
sum(rate(${prefix}_requests_total{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

(
  sum(rate(${prefix}_requests_total{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", status_code=~"4.."}[$__rate_interval]))
  or
  sum(rate(${prefix}_requests_total{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) * 0
)
/
sum(rate(${prefix}_requests_total{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Client errors by status code
panels.description: Rate of 4xx responses per status code.

targets.expr: sum by (status_code) (rate(${prefix}_requests_total{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", status_code=~"4.."}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Server errors by status code
panels.description: Rate of 5xx responses per status code.

targets.expr: sum by (status_code) (rate(${prefix}_requests_total{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", status_code=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Latency percentiles
panels.description: Request duration percentiles across the selection, from request_duration_seconds. Classic buckets and native histograms are both supported.

targets.expr:
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (rate(${prefix}_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])))
or
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum(rate(${prefix}_request_duration_seconds{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(${prefix}_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])))
or
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(${prefix}_request_duration_seconds{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(${prefix}_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])))
or
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(${prefix}_request_duration_seconds{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Latency distribution
panels.description: Requests per second by duration bucket. Shows the shapes percentiles hide, such as a second, slower mode.

targets.expr:
sum by (le) (rate(${prefix}_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))
or
(
  sum(rate(${prefix}_request_duration_seconds{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))
  unless on ()
  sum by (le) (rate(${prefix}_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))
)

panels.title: Routes
panels.description: Every instrumented route over the selected time range: average request rate, error ratios and latency percentiles. Select a route to open its detail dashboard.

targets.expr: sum by (method, path) (rate(${prefix}_requests_total{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range]))

(
  sum by (method, path) (rate(${prefix}_requests_total{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", status_code=~"5.."}[$__range]))
  or
  sum by (method, path) (rate(${prefix}_requests_total{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])) * 0
)
/
sum by (method, path) (rate(${prefix}_requests_total{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range]))

(
  sum by (method, path) (rate(${prefix}_requests_total{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", status_code=~"4.."}[$__range]))
  or
  sum by (method, path) (rate(${prefix}_requests_total{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])) * 0
)
/
sum by (method, path) (rate(${prefix}_requests_total{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range]))

histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, method, path) (rate(${prefix}_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])))
or
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (method, path) (rate(${prefix}_request_duration_seconds{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, method, path) (rate(${prefix}_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])))
or
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (method, path) (rate(${prefix}_request_duration_seconds{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, method, path) (rate(${prefix}_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])))
or
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (method, path) (rate(${prefix}_request_duration_seconds{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Top routes by request rate
panels.description: The ten busiest routes at each point in time.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (method, path) (rate(${prefix}_requests_total{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Top routes by server errors
panels.description: The ten routes answering the most 5xx responses.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (method, path) (rate(${prefix}_requests_total{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", status_code=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Slowest routes (p95)
panels.description: The ten routes with the highest p95 request duration.

targets.expr:
topk(10,
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, method, path) (rate(${prefix}_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])))
or
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (method, path) (rate(${prefix}_request_duration_seconds{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])))
)

panels.title: In-flight requests by method
panels.description: Requests being handled per method. Labeled by method only, since the gauge is incremented before routing; methods the app does not route share the OTHER series.

targets.expr: sum by (method) (${prefix}_requests_in_progress{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Payload throughput
panels.description: Body bytes per second received in requests and sent in responses, from the size histograms. Headers are not counted, and payloads of unknown length (an unannounced stream) are left out — see the prometheus middleware README.

targets.expr:
sum(rate(${prefix}_request_size_bytes_sum{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))
or
histogram_sum(sum(rate(${prefix}_request_size_bytes{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])))

sum(rate(${prefix}_response_size_bytes_sum{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))
or
histogram_sum(sum(rate(${prefix}_response_size_bytes{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Top routes by response bandwidth
panels.description: The ten routes sending the most response body bytes per second, from response_size_bytes.

targets.expr:
topk(10,
sum by (method, path) (rate(${prefix}_response_size_bytes_sum{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))
or
histogram_sum(sum by (method, path) (rate(${prefix}_response_size_bytes{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])))
)
